name: Guguko
source:
Department of Game Design (taking a year off); Rock pigeon

An undergrad student who had no intention of storming the lab. She merely got swept up in it all and found herself here.

An undergrad who kept working because she couldn't get a word out about her not storming the lab. These days, she feels quite comfortable here.
